sections.headline: Five engines. Up to six stems.
sections.lede: Demucs, MDX, Roformer, Spleeter and DrumSep. Choose the model and the stem count before you split.
sections.body:
### What comes out
- Vocals, drums, bass, piano, guitar and other
- 4 to 6 stems per track
- GPU acceleration, plus a CPU-only mode that works but is slower

images.alt: Liminal StemSplit separating a track in real time

sections.photoCredit: Real screenshot · stems ready, with waveforms, transport and stem controls.
sections.headline: Queue the whole album.
sections.lede: Batch processing with an unlimited queue. Load the tracks and let it run overnight.
sections.body: Each stem gets a waveform, transport and its own controls as soon as the split finishes. Import straight from YouTube, and turn separated vocals into text with **Whisper transcription** for lyrics, captions and timestamped notes.

images.alt: Liminal StemSplit with separated stems ready to review

sections.photoCredit: Real screenshot · the per-stem Pro FX rack.
sections.headline: Shape every stem in the FX rack.
sections.lede: 18 FX modules per stem, built in. Go from split to finished stems in one app.
sections.body: EQ, compressor, reverb, delay, saturation, stereo widener, pitch shifter and more, applied to each stem on its own. Ships with 20+ FX presets.

images.alt: Liminal Pro FX rack open on the vocal stem

sections.headline: One price. Lifetime access.
sections.lede: ==$29 one-time.== All future updates included. No subscriptions and no recurring fees. Backed by a **30-day money-back guarantee**.
sections.body:
### System requirements
- Windows 10 or later (macOS and Linux coming soon)
- 8 GB RAM, or 16 GB for large batches
- NVIDIA GPU with 4 GB+ VRAM for the fastest processing; CPU-only works but is slower

### Installing
Windows may show a SmartScreen notice for new independent software: choose **More info → Run anyway**, and check the SHA-256 checksum published with the installer.

### 30-day money-back guarantee
If Liminal Pro isn't right for you, email within 30 days of purchase with the address you used at checkout for a full refund.
